source.content: @isTest private class CoreRuntimeInvocableActionInputParameterEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { Invocable.Action action = Invocable.Action.createStandardAction('localNoop'); action.addInvocation(); action.setInvocationParameter('name', 'Trail'); Invocable.Action.DescribeResult describe = action.getDescribe()[0]; List<Invocable.Action.InputParameter> inputs = describe.getInputs(); System.assertEquals(1, inputs.size()); Invocable.Action.InputParameter input = inputs[0]; System.assertEquals(0, input.getAdditionalAttributes().size()); System.assertEquals('', input.getApexClass()); System.assertEquals(0, input.getByteLength()); System.assertEquals(false, input.getConfiguration()); System.assertEquals(null, input.getDefaultValue()); System.assertEquals('', input.getDescription()); System.assertEquals('name', input.getLabel()); System.assertEquals(1, input.getMaxOccurs()); System.assertEquals('name', input.getName()); System.assertEquals(0, input.getPicklistValues().size()); System.assertEquals('', input.getPlaceholderText()); System.assertEquals(false, input.getRequired()); System.assertEquals('', input.getSObjectType()); System.assertEquals(0, input.getSetupReferenceType().size()); System.assertEquals('String', input.getToolingType()); System.assertEquals('String', input.getType()); } }
